story: A gout flare told in the group chat, linked to a medicine question in a private chat six weeks later

messages.text: Quick update on 1001-101: at today's visit she said she had a gout flare in her left big toe last week. Her GP started colchicine 0.6 mg daily.
1001-101's toe is sore again. Before her next dose: is any medicine she is on a problem under the protocol?
